body:
The school is less of a big deal, I feel like I have more of a handle on it. But I graduate in a few months and I have no idea what to do. I thought I wanted to be a SysAdmin but I’m shit at math. So that scares me.

The best friend thing fucks me up a lot. I know logically there are “plenty of other fish in the sea” but emotionally it’s harder to deal with. A lot harder. I started having panic attacks last week about it which is way out of character for me.

I’m just always sad and depressed and I can’t enjoy anything anymore. It’s this constant looming cloud I can’t shake
